result.title: ConClick: Element-Wise Contrastive Learning Improves GUI Grounding
result.comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, including references and appendices. Code and data: https://github.com/zhangruotian/ConClick
result.summary: GUI grounding, the task of locating the interface element specified by a user instruction, is a fundamental capability of GUI agents. However, existing grounding models remain error-prone, often causing downstream task failures. We systematically evaluate 10 grounding models across five datasets and identify a major error pattern: most incorrect clicks hit non-target interface elements rather than the background, with different models repeatedly selecting the same distractors. Motivated by these findings, we propose ConClick, a contrastive learning framework that teaches models to distinguish the target element from plausible distractors. We construct ConClick-Data, a dataset containing 4,292 challenging target-distractor pairs, and train the model using complementary listwise ranking and pairwise margin objectives. ConClick improves the grounding accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B from 54.71% to 66.03% on ScreenSpot-Pro, from 83.72% to 86.28% on MMBench-GUI L2, and from 63.33% to 70.20% on OSWorld-G, outperforming prior methods built on the same or similarly sized backbones. We further introduce ReClick, an inference-time strategy that revisits promising regions and compares predictions across competing candidates, yielding an additional 2.96 percentage-point improvement in average accuracy across the three benchmarks. Together, our analysis, dataset, and methods provide both empirical insights and practical tools for building more reliable GUI agents. Data and code are available at https://github.com/zhangruotian/ConClick.

AI.brief_summary: 论文系统评估10个GUI grounding模型，发现多数错误点击落在非目标元素而非背景，且不同模型反复选中同一批干扰项；据此提出ConClick，用4,292对target-distractor数据结合listwise排序与pairwise margin对比学习，并给出推理期重访候选区域的ReClick策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「区分目标与近邻干扰项」的训练思路与推理期重访候选、比较预测的做法，可能与LVR中视觉证据筛选、动态计算与停止/复核决策存在可核查的对应线索；但论文只报告点击准确率，未涉及内部状态与推理轨迹，迁移价值需阅读原文后判断。
